page.overview:
Who is Asharru?

Mistress Asharru was a merchant warrior from Ank'Harel and one of the previous owners of Cabal's Ruin.

Mistress Asharru was a woman in her mid-to-late forties. She had black hair with white streaks throughout it. Her left eye was ruined and sealed closed with a scar. She wore ornate scale mail armor that was black and purple.

After Vox Machina passed Kamaljiori's test, he told them of the current wearer of Cabal's Ruin: "a merchant-warrior with a missing eye in the walls of Ank'Harel."

Anna Ripley, who had been able to listen in on Vox Machina through an enchantment on her old pistol that Percival de Rolo was carrying, tasked Kynan Leore with quietly killing Mistress Asharru, but he failed at the last moment to cut Asharru's throat, so the rest of the party had to rush in and kill her in a less stealthy manner. Worried about detection, the party fled the city quickly, gaining as much distance as they could before the body was discovered.
